clips.title: The story
paras: A Difficult Path marks the formal beginning of a Forsaken paladin's training in Deathknell. After dealing with the mindless undead rising from the crypts, newly awakened champions of the Light are directed to Aramis Hammerhand within the village church to confront the agonizing reality of wielding holy energy in undeath.

When a freshly awakened Forsaken paladin finishes culling the feral undead outside the crypt, Shadow Priest Sarvis hands over an unexpected delivery. The Consecrated Scroll radiates holy energy so intensely that the shadow priest visibly recoils, bluntly asking the bearer to step aside. To a practitioner of shadow and decay, the very aura of the Holy Light feels like an open flame.

Inside the desecrated church of Deathknell awaits Aramis Hammerhand, the Forsaken paladin trainer. Where other races wield the Light naturally and joyfully, undead who call upon it endure searing, visceral agony. Aramis makes no attempt to soften the blow: channeling holy power through a rotting vessel is sheer torment, but he demands his disciples embrace the pain rather than flinch away, using it as a crucible to temper their newfound resolve.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine its of some importance to a paladin like yourself.
Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your training can now begin in earnest, paladin. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
